title: no-redundant-condition-on-mixed (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: Independent nested empty checks can both pass or either fail; neither guard is constant for mixed shape values. This is not a claim that arbitrary mixed receivers support offsets: an ordinary object is a failing runtime control.

allowed.reason: mixed includes objects without ArrayAccess, which fail even under empty; the runtime object control independently proves this concern. This does not claim either empty test is constant.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago agrees with the scoped expectation.
